summary: Engage is battlefield-specific for every card (R-064): a Personality/Follower/Item taking an Engage must be at the engaged battlefield and its targets must be there too; Home/Absent Engages and the Engage texts naming another location are exempt by ability id (EngageRules.cs). Newly enforced for Khalimpeh-jiak, Iuchi Takaki, Shosuro Takazaki, The Yari of the Shabura, New Cavalry Tactics and the Engage fixtures; The Bestial Ones moved to the general rule.
validation: bash tools/check.sh --skip-client green; full Core suite 4463/4463 before the new tests; new engage-battlefield suite sweeps every Engage unit card away from the battlefield and checks target lists, and fails (Khalimpeh-jiak, Takaki) when the rule is reverted
remaining: None; ready for review. Strategies/Items played from hand and Strongholds/Holdings/Regions are governed by their own printed text, unchanged.
